response.sql: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM invoice_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share;
